environment.description: Identical Celery worker deployment on ECS Fargate. Split.io Relay Proxy v5.x sidecar container runs in the same task definition (localhost:3141), with SDK key configured and streaming connection maintained to Split cloud. The split 'use_legacy_query_builder' is configured with default rule returning 'off' treatment, kill switch enabled since 2024-01-15. The Split SDK is initialized pointing to the local relay proxy (SPLIT_SYNC_PROXY_URL=http://localhost:3141). Even if the relay proxy becomes temporarily unreachable, the SDK's in-memory cache retains the last-known 'off' treatment from its most recent sync (SDK impression persistence with localStorage fallback disabled in worker mode, but in-memory segment cache TTL of 3600s applies). The environment variable SPLIT_DEFAULT_USE_LEGACY_QUERY_BUILDER is set to 'off' as defense-in-depth.

config.split_relay_proxy: v5.4.1 sidecar in same task definition
config.split_flag_state: use_legacy_query_builder: off (kill switch active, default rule off)
config.task_definition_health_check: relay proxy health checked, task marked unhealthy if proxy fails for >60s
